title: Fixed Open Well and Wire Basket Fryer
description: One original complete static countertop basket-fryer appearance. A thick rectangular open well with an actual inner floor and four walls sits on four grounded feet. A taller rear control housing with blank fascia and fixed dial belongs to this appliance. A complete five-sided open-lattice basket is held in one raised fixed position by two whole side resting lugs over the well rim; the bottom and four sides contain true finite square openings, never dark painted spots. A whole long open-loop lifting handle projects from its front and ends in a dark grip. Three opaque untextured PBR roles. Newly authored complete equipment, not the old long vented brazier or laboratory sink relabelled. One prop and zero scenes; no oil, food, heating element, cord, moving basket, cooking process, electrical operation, food-contact, load or safety claim.
